chunks: Hold back this young man on my behalf, lest he causes my ruin, because I am loath to send these two (meaning al-Hasan and al-Husayn, peace be upon them) towards death, lest the descending line of the Prophet - may Allah bless him and his descendants - is cut away by their death.

key_terms.نَسْلُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ: the lineage/descendants of the Messenger of Allah

ai.seo_question: Why did Ali want to hold back Hasan from fighting at Siffin?
ai.summary: In this poignant moment from the Battle of Siffin, Ali ibn Abi Talib commands Hasan to hold back, fearing that the young prince’s eager advance might result in premature martyrdom. This reflects the Shia scholarly emphasis on the preservation of the Prophet’s progeny (Banu Hashim) as essential for the continuity of divine guidance and the Imamate. By prioritizing Hasan’s survival, Ali ensures the unbroken lineage through both Hasan and Husayn, securing the future of the Ahl al-Bayt.
